basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated building in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods. The property features two large flats, each with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, fully renovated down to the studs with modern finishes and open layouts.  Below the flats are two separate studios, each with its own private entrance, perfect for rental income, guests, or extended family. The garage provides parking for up to four vehicles along with convenient storage space.  On top, a brand-new roof deck showcases sweeping views of the San Francisco Bay and city skyline, creating the perfect spot for relaxing or entertaining.  All of this is set in a prime location near North Beach, Fisherman's Wharf, Coit Tower, Washington Square, and just steps from the area's best shops, cafes, and restaurants.  This is a unique opportunity to own a turn-key property that combines flexible living options with the best of San Francisco at your doorstep.
